clauses.name: Gar Fild, the Malleable
clauses.printedParagraph: If Gar Fild wins the confrontation, gain 4 {T} essences. These essences are not lost at the end of the turn.
clauses.expectedBehavior: A live face-up Manifestation that actually participated on the winning side queues its wins-confrontation trigger exactly once. A loser, non-participant, hidden or disabled source does not trigger. The valid action begins the printed retained-Essence, delayed return, choice, control, reveal or exchange result.
